dedupe_keys.name: indicators of irrigation water demand in sweden under climate scenarios s hype 1981 2100

description: This dataset gives three indicators of irrigation water demand for every catchment in Sweden: the start date of crop growth, the number of days a year when crop water demand exceeds soil water without irrigation, and the total irrigation water required, for nine crop groups, an average and the driest year, four 30-year periods from 1981 to 2100 and three emission pathways (RCP 2.6, 4.5 and 8.5). It was computed with SMHI's S-HYPE hydrological model driven by 17 bias-adjusted Euro-CORDEX regional climate models. Researchers at Lund University and the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute published it on Zenodo in January 2025 as zipped files, available as a free download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is national. Caveats: demand volumes depend on an assumed application depth per irrigation event (22 mm, with 15 and 30 mm variants), and the driest year differs between catchments. Simulation uses: future irrigation demand for water allocation, capacity planning and drought adaptation. Related record: the global maximum irrigation extent map (data-gmie-global-maximum-irrigation-extent).
name: Indicators of irrigation water demand in Sweden under climate scenarios (S-HYPE, 1981-2100)
